archReview.notes: Adds RVV (zve32x) HEVC qpel/epel weighted-pel kernels: 30 functions (qpel/epel x uni_w/bi_w x h/v/hv x 8/9/10/12-bit) covering all checkasm_hevc_pel weighted hotspots. Uses e8/e16 source loads, vwmaccsu/vwmacc signed-signed accumulate into e32, vnsrl narrowing, vmax/vmin clipping. Runtime filter selection via PC-relative table lookup; calls follow the 13-arg convention (extra args on stack, branchless ops only). No unsupported extensions beyond RVV 1.0 zve32x; zve32x func attribute matches RVV_I32 gate. Stack frame 12800 B with full callee-saved restore before return.
